rule: HARD SAFETY for self-evolution. A playbook recovery job must never itself trigger another playbook. Implementation: (1) recovery note MUST start with 'playbook:'; (2) recovery id MUST NOT match the lesson match regex in a way that re-fires; (3) foreman skips if note.startswith('playbook:') or id contains diag_after_budget / recovery markers; (4) lessons that only teach (no enqueue) leave match empty or omit enqueue. Breaking this rule creates infinity loops and burns the host. Measured 2026-08-08: ~20 chained diag jobs before guard landed.
